name: The Blood Stone

effects.name: Seeker
effects.tooltip: Seeker +6 : Provides a +6 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

effects.name: Deception
effects.tooltip: Deception +4 : +4 Enhancement bonus to hit and +6 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.

effects.name: Accuracy
effects.tooltip: Accuracy +9 : Passive: +9 Competence bonus to attack rolls

effects.name: Deadly
effects.tooltip: Deadly +5 : +5 Competence bonus to weapon damage.

effects.name: Vulkoor's Chosen
effects.tooltip: Vulkoor's Chosen : 2 Pieces Equipped: +10 Artifact bonus to Poison Resistance +1 Artifact bonus to Sneak Attack Dice +1 Artifact bonus to Saving Throws +1 Artifact bonus to Dexterity and Constitution

flavor_text: A featureless blood red stone. Visions of murder and mayhem possess you the first time you pick up the Bloodstone.
tips: This item used to be known as " Bloodstone " before Update 9 , which was easily confused with the basic gem of the same name . Can also be used in Catalyst Crafting to make The Bloody Boulder

source.detail: The Thirsty One and Palumak the Scourer chests ; Masei Mkembe sells for 625 Antique Bronze Tokens (sold as 'Bloodstone'); Epic Zawabi's Revenge Warded chest.
